title: Expectations, evidence and building a promotion case that survives a panel

videos.script: Yara wants to be considered for staff engineer. Renata thinks she is ready. {{title}} Ready is a conclusion. The panel that decides has never met Yara, and will not take Renata's word for it. {{panel}} So Renata sorts what she has into two piles. Work with a date and an outcome somebody else could check. And things that are true, and do not count. Effort, years, being liked. {{piles}} Then she maps each piece to a row of the ladder, and writes one claim per row. {{rows}} She writes down what is thin, before the panel finds it. {{gaps}} This lesson is about that case. And about the conversation after the panel, when the answer is no. {{no}}
